errors.evidence: The description invents the category "малки собствени земеделски производители" (small own farmers). The actual category label in the figure is "растиниевъдни" (crop-growing).
The description invents the category "винарни" (wineries). The actual category label in the figure is "висше образование" (higher education).

The description invents the category "личен добив" (personal yield). The actual category label in the figure is "наличие на рисково събитие през последните 5 години" (presence of a risk event in the last 5 years).

The description incorrectly translates/interprets a label as "налични на горско стопанство" (available at a forest holding). This seems to be a confused interpretation of two separate labels: "наличие на рисково събитие..." and "висше образование".

The categories on the x-axis are not arranged in alphabetical order. The order is: "големи стопанства", "растиниевъдни", "животновъдни", "висше образование", etc., which does not follow an alphabetical sequence.

errors.evidence: This statement incorrectly describes the order of the bars by value. The second highest bar is 72% (which is omitted), followed by 67%. The description incorrectly lists the 58% bar before the 67% bar.

errors.evidence: The description correctly identifies the lowest value (38%) but assigns it to an incorrect, misinterpreted category name ("налични на горско стопанство"). The correct category for 38% is "висше образование" (higher education).
